name: X (Entry) Visa for Foreign Spouses

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be the foreign spouse of an Indian citizen or an OCI cardholder, evidenced by a registered marriage certificate.
Must register with the FRRO if the continuous stay exceeds 180 days.

evidence_required.document: Registered marriage certificate (apostilled if issued abroad)
Spouse's Indian passport or OCI card with linked foreign passport

outcome.duration_length: commonly up to 5 years, varying by issuing mission and documentation

sources.title: NRI Information (private information site) -- X (Entry) Visa for foreign spouse of an Indian citizen or OCI cardholder: available immediately on marriage (no waiting period, unlike OCI's 2-year requirement), typically issued up to 5 years, FRRO registration required beyond 180 days, convertible to OCI status after the marriage subsists 2 years

Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India -- Foreigners Registration: multiple-entry X-visa holders visiting for family/social reasons must register with the FRRO within 14 days if continuous stay exceeds 180 days; subsequent travels on the same visa do not require re-registration

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (India). STATUS: DRAFT -- the X-Visa is confirmed as a real, official category (referenced by name in the tier-1 MEA foreigners-registration page and by multiple Indian diplomatic mission sites), but every official mission page attempted in this build for its specific spousal eligibility/duration detail returned a 403 error, an SSL certificate error, or a redirect loop; the eligibility and duration detail here rests on a private information site (tier 4) rather than a government source, hence draft rather than published despite the category itself being unambiguously real. Distinct from in_ancestry_oci.json (the OCI card): the X-visa is available immediately on marriage with no waiting period, while OCI eligibility via marriage requires the registered marriage to subsist for 2 continuous years first -- this X-visa is what a newly married foreign spouse actually lives on in the interim, and the natural on-ramp to OCI (or full citizenship by registration under in_citizenship_by_registration.json) once that 2-year mark passes.
